'''Vokoff-Strood''' was the manufacturer of the [[Plug-8G 927 Cluster Array engine|Plug-8G 927]] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] and the [[Titan 2150 rocket engine/Legends|Titan 2150]] Podracer. The company also produced the [[Plug-8G Cluster Array engine|Plug-8G]] engines used in a Cluster Array configuration on the [[Plug-8G 927 Cluster Array engine|Plug-8G 927]]. During the Old Republic period the company produced the [[STAR-94 engine system]] in use on Republic strike and scout fighters<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'' {{Mo}}</ref> They also produced the [[VT-22 light troop transport|VT-22 Light Troop Transport]], a ship that found use in the navy of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire.]]
